name: fleet-canvas
description: Private command and control for a Tailscale-connected compute fleet

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @fleet/core && npm run build -w @fleet/agent && npm run dev -w @fleet/desktop
scripts.dev:web: cross-env FLEET_TOKEN=fleet-canvas-local-development-recovery-token-0001 concurrently -k -n core,agent,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @fleet/core -- --allow-unauthenticated-loopback" "npm run dev:agent" "npm run dev:web -w @fleet/desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fleet/shared && npm run build -w @fleet/sdk && npm run build -w @fleet/desktop && npm run build -w @fleet/agent && npm run build -w @fleet/core && npm run build -w @fleet/mcp && npm run build -w @fleet/plugin-sdk && npm run build -w @fleet/simulator
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @fleet/shared && npm run build -w @fleet/sdk && npm run typecheck -ws --if-present
scripts.test:portable: npm run test -w @fleet/desktop && npm run test -w @fleet/mcp && npm run test -w @fleet/plugin-sdk && npm run test -w @fleet/sdk && npm run test -w @fleet/shared && npm run test -w @fleet/simulator
scripts.verify: npm run audit:publication && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm audit --audit-level=high
